description: Define purpose, owner, population, fields, refresh, privacy and conflict rules before proposing implementation.

guide.applicability: Use when the project can supply authoritative taxonomy, identity and governance requirements.
guide.context_boundary: Documentation cannot authorize identity joins, membership mutation or sensitive trait derivation.
steps: Resolve tag purpose, owner, subject identity, eligible population, inputs, refresh and retention policy.
Check semantic conflicts, sensitivity, versioning and measurement requirements against project Context.
Return a value-free contract proposal; require separate governed computation and Action preview for membership changes.
guide.title: User tag contract proposal

summary: Design a project tag contract without computing or writing tag membership.
